title: Polar Watch Not Charging on Cable
shortDescription: Polar Vantage/Grit X/Pacer does not charge when plugged in.
fullDescription: Polar uses a proprietary 4-pin clip cable. Sweat residue corroding the contacts is the leading cause of charge failure, followed by an out-of-spec USB port.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Use cotton swab with isopropyl on watch and cable contacts.

fixSteps.title: Try wall adapter
fixSteps.instruction: Use a 5V/1A wall adapter instead of laptop USB.

whenToCallPro: Polar warranty if cleaning + new cable doesn't help.

title: Polar Watch Cannot Find GPS Signal
fullDescription: Polar watches need fresh A-GPS data, synced via Polar Flow when paired with phone. Stale A-GPS data causes long fix times.

fixSteps.title: Sync Flow
fixSteps.instruction: Open Polar Flow app to push fresh A-GPS data.

fixSteps.title: Open sky
fixSteps.instruction: Stand outdoors with clear sky for 1-2 min.

title: Polar H10 Strap Disconnects During Workout
fullDescription: H10 drops are usually low CR2025 battery, dry electrodes, or loose strap fit.

title: Polar Flow App Will Not Sync Watch
shortDescription: Sync hangs at percentage or fails outright.
fullDescription: Sync requires Bluetooth, location, and Flow app current version. Background app refresh disabled is a top cause on iPhone.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > General > Pair and sync, remove + add device.

faq.a: Some Polar models support FlowSync via Wi-Fi; most use Bluetooth.

title: Polar Watch Side Button Stuck
shortDescription: Physical button doesn't click or stays pressed.
fullDescription: Sweat and salt buildup beneath the button rubber gasket cause sticking. Rinsing under warm running water while pressing the button often clears it.

fixSteps.title: Rinse
fixSteps.instruction: Run under warm water, pressing button repeatedly.

whenToCallPro: If button still stuck after rinse, send to Polar service.

faq.a: Yes — most models 100m WR, safe to rinse.

title: Polar Watch Glass Cracked
shortDescription: Visible crack on the watch face.
fullDescription: Glass cracks are not covered under warranty. Polar service can replace the glass on flagship models; cheaper to replace some lower-tier watches.

fixSteps.title: Service quote
fixSteps.instruction: Submit RMA to Polar for repair quote.

title: Polar Firmware Update Stuck or Failed
shortDescription: Update over Polar Flow halts mid-progress.
fullDescription: Firmware updates can take 20+ min. Bluetooth dropouts or low battery interrupt the install. Restart phone, charge watch, retry.

fixSteps.title: Use FlowSync desktop
fixSteps.instruction: Try update via FlowSync on Mac/PC instead of phone.

faq.a: Yes on Mac and Windows desktop.

title: Polar Touchscreen Won't Respond
fullDescription: Polar disables touch during workouts and when wet. Soft reset usually clears stuck-touch states.

title: Polar Watch Band Tore or Pin Lost
fullDescription: Polar uses quick-release pins on most models. Replacement bands are inexpensive and self-installable.

fixSteps.title: Replace band
fixSteps.instruction: Buy OEM strap; squeeze pin tabs to install.

title: Polar Wrist Heart Rate Reads Inaccurate
shortDescription: Wrist optical HR shows wrong values during exercise.
fullDescription: Optical HR drifts during high-intensity intervals due to motion, dark tattoos, or loose fit. Use H10 strap for accuracy.

fixSteps.title: Tighten band
fixSteps.instruction: Wear 1-2 fingers above wrist bone, snug.

fixSteps.title: Use chest strap
fixSteps.instruction: Pair H10 for accuracy in HIIT.

faq.a: Yes — bicep/forearm is more accurate for some users.
